args: alias.magos-mcp=!cd "./${GIT_PREFIX:-}" || exit 1; export PYTHONUTF8=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath=1; for c in python3 "py -3" python; do command -v "${c%% *}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; $c -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 9))" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; exec $c -X utf8 -B scripts/magos_guard.py mcp; done; echo "MAGOS guard: no Python 3.9 or later found (tried python3, py -3, python)" >&2; exit 127
